candidates.name: Cable Wrist Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Wrist Extension
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Start with your elbow at a 90 degree angle with your palm facing down. Flex and extend at the wrist.

candidates.name: Cable Wrist Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Wrist Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

candidates.name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl
Novice
1
Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face the cable machine.
3
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm down. Flex at the elbow and extend.

candidates.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
Intermediate
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

candidates.name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.

candidates.name: Cable Braced Wrist Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable Braced Wrist Curl
Novice
1
Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm up holding handle.
2
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in forearm flexors.
3
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm at the top.

candidates.name: Cable Braced Wrist Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Braced Wrist Extension
Novice
1
Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm down holding handle.
2
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
3
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.

candidates.name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards, and curl.

candidates.name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
candidates.cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards, as you curl hinge forward.
4
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.
